text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After resting in the cafe for a while, drowsiness leaves my whole body feeling sluggish.
I don't have much motivation...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Well, isn't this a rather long siesta?
Careful, or the sun will leave you behind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The one who addressed me in that distinct manner was Tanino Gimlet. Was she trying to imply that my break was dragging on a bit too long...?
choice_data_list: I just can't find the motivation...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Hmph, are you wandering through a labyrinth?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
No choice, then. In that case, I shall build you
a stairway leading back to the mortal realm.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Lime juice as the base, with a dash of spice—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —I call it... "The Flower of Evil."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A non-alcoholic cocktail was offered,
so I decided to try a sip. But—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The instant my lips touched the glass, an intense, electrifying numbness spread throughout my mouth...!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Kuhahaha!! Yes, let your voices ring out!!
Scream!! Writhe in agony!!
choice_data_list: Why would you eat something this spicy……?!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —To feel the vivid pulse of the "now."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Pain is the trigger for the 'now.'
Something that makes you feel the instant, awakening you.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
And pursuing the "now" is where true strength
and speed reside――...
Not just in your running, but in your thinking.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Right this very moment... hasn't power begun welling up inside you?
Or perhaps your thoughts have started spinning in dizzying overdrive?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Now that you mention it,
did my condition change somehow,
or did it not...?
choice_data_list: I think power might be surging through me!
My brain might finally be starting to work!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha!! Exactly!!
I can hear it too... the surging tide of your raw brawn!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: With who you are now, you should be able to vanquish even the bull-headed monster and find your way out of the labyrinth!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I shall entrust you with Ariadne's thread...
――Now, draw your blade! Venture forth into battle!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha!! Exactly!!
I can hear it—the sound of your thoughts accelerating into overdrive!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Transcend mythology, rebirth, and romanticism—
Do not fear the grotesque...
Lay your egoism bare!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I am, you are――
HERE, in this place, RIGHT NOW!!!!
